messages:
Marta Chen: heads-up I need to sign off in 25m. handoff plan: Aisha as primary, Ravi secondary. there's a short-term coverage ask: contractor Tom needs responder access for a customer experiment tonight. need PD responder, grafana ack perms, and an aws assume-role. flagging security for fast review.

Aisha Patel: I can take primary. quick clarification: Tom, do you need to modify dashboards or only ack/annotate alerts?

Tom Nguyen: only ack/annotate and view traces in AWS. no dashboard edits.

Ravi Singh: usual pattern is temp assume-role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/OncallTempSession with duration 8h. PD: add as Responder on services "inference-api" and "edge-router". Grafana: viewer + alert-ack group membership TTL 8h.

Marta Chen: my standard checklist (posting so ops & sec can confirm):\n- PagerDuty: add to rotation or grant Responder role scoped to the minimal services.\n- Grafana: add to "oncall-temp-ack" group (Viewer + ack permission).\n- AWS: allow sts:AssumeRole on OncallTempSession with session duration 28800 and CloudTrail entry tagged.\n- Record approval and expiry in ticket INC-4598 (I'll open it now).

Marta Chen: runbook links for quick refs: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff, https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pagerduty-quickcheck, https://redwood.internal/runbooks/grafana-temp-access

Marta Chen: quick acceptance tests to paste here after grants:
```
# PagerDuty - check identity
pd whoami || echo \"not in PD\"

# Grafana - visit https://grafana.redwood.internal/dashboards (no 403, alerts visible)

# AWS assume-role
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/OncallTempSession --role-session-name tom-handoff --duration-seconds 28800
```

Ravi Singh: I'm adding Tom to PD now for the two services. @ops-bot please record the PD change.

ops-bot: pagerduty-bot: updated responders for [inference-api, edge-router]  added Tom Nguyen as Responder. change logged by Ravi Singh.

Aisha Patel: Grafana: I can create temporary membership in group "oncall-temp-ack" with TTL 8h. that group gives ack permission without full edit rights. @Marta ok to proceed and note approval in ticket?

Marta Chen: yes please proceed. reason: "overnight contractor cover - INC-4598". include expiry timestamp in the ticket and link to this thread.

Tom Nguyen: added justification in INC-4598. once granted I'll run the checks and paste outputs here.

security: Reminder from security: temporary access must require MFA, be least-privilege, and have session logging. tagging @security for approval comment in INC-4598.

Ravi Singh: AWS preparations done: policy scoped, CloudTrail marker added. awaiting security sign-off on the ticket.

pagerduty-bot: Incident rotation update  tonight primary: Aisha Patel, secondary: Ravi Singh, temp responder: Tom Nguyen. PD change id: pdchg-7921.

Aisha Patel: Tom is in Grafana group oncall-temp-ack now. Tom try acking a non-prod alert and confirm.

Tom Nguyen: non-prod ack succeeded. pd whoami shows me as Responder. aws sts assume-role returned creds. partial outputs below:\n\n$ pd whoami\nUser: tom.nguyen@redwood (Responder)\n\n$ aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/OncallTempSession --role-session-name tom-handoff --duration-seconds 28800\n{\n  \"Credentials\": {\n    \"AccessKeyId\": \"ASIA...\",\n    \"SecretAccessKey\": \"***\",\n    \"SessionToken\": \"***\",\n    \"Expiration\": \"2024-10-02T07:45:00Z\"\n  }\n}\n
Marta Chen: excellent. updated action items:\n1) Ravi - confirm PD change is linked and evidence attached to INC-4598 (in progress)\n2) Aisha - verify Grafana TTL and add expiry note to ticket (done)\n3) Security - final approval comment and set enforced expiry via IAM/Okta (requested)\n4) Tom - follow the handoff runbook for any pages and post escalations to #eng-oncall\n
Ravi Singh: PD change logged and linked in INC-4598. closing my tasks.

security: automated note - security approval required. please add explicit approval in INC-4598 with proof of TTL and MFA requirement.

Marta Chen: leaving now  Aisha you're primary. I'll be reachable by DM for 45m. please ping if anything odd comes up.

Aisha Patel: thanks Marta. I'll post a post-handoff summary and expiry timestamps in the ticket once security approves. ping me if you notice any missing services that should be in PD scope.
